property.name: chatHeight
property.label: Chat Height (px)
property.description: Height of the chat window in pixels

property.name: primaryColor
property.label: Primary Color
property.description: Primary color for (Header background, chat logo, floating chat icon). Use Action Color from Experience Cloud theme.

property.name: floatingIconColor
property.label: Floating Icon Color
property.description: Color for the floating chat icon.

property.name: headerTextColor
property.label: Header Text Color
property.description: Text color for the header area.

property.name: multiAgentFlag
property.label: Multi Agent Flag
property.description: Flag to show/hide the multi agent dropdown.

property.name: startChatButtonColor
property.label: Start Chat Button Background
property.description: Background color for the Start A New Chat button.

property.name: startChatButtonTextColor
property.label: Start Chat Button Text Color
property.description: Text color for the Start A New Chat button.

property.name: selectAgentDialogBackgroundColor
property.label: Agent Dropdown Dialog Background Color
property.description: Background color for the agent dropdown dialog.

property.name: chatBackgroundColor
property.label: Chat Background Color
property.description: Background color for the chat messages area.

property.name: userMessageBackgroundColor
property.label: User Message Background
property.description: Background color for user message bubbles.

property.name: userMessageTextColor
property.label: User Message Text Color
property.description: Text color for user messages.

property.name: botMessageBackgroundColor
property.label: Bot Message Background
property.description: Background color for bot/AI message bubbles.

property.name: botMessageTextColor
property.label: Bot Message Text Color
property.description: Text color for bot/AI messages.

property.name: inputTextColor
property.label: Input Text Color
property.description: Text color for the message input field.

property.name: inputBorderColor
property.label: Input Border Color
property.description: Border color for the message input field.

property.name: attachmentIconColor
property.label: Attachment Icon Color
property.description: Color for the attachment/link icon.

property.name: sendIconColor
property.label: Send Icon Color
property.description: Color for the send button icon.

property.name: botLogoUrl
property.label: Bot Logo URL
property.description: Full URL for custom bot avatar logo. For Static Resources in Experience Cloud, use: YourResourceName. For internal SF, use: YourResourceName. Leave empty to use default GPTfy logo.

property.name: chatMessageFontSize
property.label: Chat Message Font Size (px)
property.description: Font size for chat messages in pixels. Default is 14px.

property.name: chatFontFamily
property.label: Chat Font Family
property.description: Font family for all chat text. Default is Salesforce Sans.

property.name: chatAvatarIconName
property.label: Chat Avatar Icon Name
property.description: Name of the chat avatar icon. Default is utility:chat.
